market_outlook.short_term: Choppy, risk-off bias. Oil at $100 and yen surge create headwinds. Fed uncertainty and inflation data this week dominate. Expect 3-5% volatility in equities. Energy outperforms; tech selective. Bond markets in flight-to-quality mode. September seasonality adds downside pressure.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural commodity upcycle (copper, rare earths, oil) supports energy/materials. AI infrastructure capex continues but monetization gap widens. U.S. fiscal trajectory ($1.25T interest) pressures long-duration assets. China consumer weakness caps global growth. Diversification across geographies and asset classes essential.
